You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From b674deddeb49fd37b8f20a15b658abde6671e2a8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Lukas Bulwahn <lukas.bulwahn@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Sep 2022 09:52:55 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] MAINTAINERS: drop entry to removed file in ARM/RISCPC
 ARCHITECTURE

Commit c1fe8d054c0a ("ARM: riscpc: use GENERIC_IRQ_MULTI_HANDLER") removes
arch/arm/include/asm/hardware/entry-macro-iomd.S, but missed to adjust
MAINTAINERS.

Hence, ./scripts/get_maintainer.pl --self-test=patterns complains about a
broken reference.

Drop the file entry to the removed file in ARM/RISCPC ARCHITECTURE.

Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/20220919075255.386-1-lukas.bulwahn@gmail.com
Fixes: c1fe8d054c0a ("ARM: riscpc: use GENERIC_IRQ_MULTI_HANDLER")
Signed-off-by: Lukas Bulwahn <lukas.bulwahn@gmail.com>
Cc: Ard Biesheuvel <ardb@kernel.org>
Cc: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Cc: Russell King <linux@armlinux.org.uk>
Signed-off-by: Andrew Morton <akpm@linux-foundation.org>

diff --git a/MAINTAINERS b/MAINTAINERS
index 589517372408..b8dc03c66484 100644
--- a/MAINTAINERS
+++ b/MAINTAINERS
@@ -2670,7 +2670,6 @@ M:	Russell King <linux@armlinux.org.uk>
 L:	linux-arm-kernel@lists.infradead.org (moderated for non-subscribers)
 S:	Maintained
 W:	http://www.armlinux.org.uk/
-F:	arch/arm/include/asm/hardware/entry-macro-iomd.S
 F:	arch/arm/include/asm/hardware/ioc.h
 F:	arch/arm/include/asm/hardware/iomd.h
 F:	arch/arm/include/asm/hardware/memc.h
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **MAINTAINERS**
   - The entry for the file `arch/arm/include/asm/hardware/entry-macro-iomd.S` has been removed from the MAINTAINERS file. This change reflects the fact that the file has been deleted in a previous commit (c1fe8d054c0a).

### Relationships

- The modification in the MAINTAINERS file is directly related to the removal of the `entry-macro-iomd.S` file in the ARM/RISCPC architecture, as indicated by the commit message. The removal of the file entry resolves a broken reference that was causing issues with the `get_maintainer.pl` script, which checks for valid file references in the MAINTAINERS file. This patch ensures that the MAINTAINERS file accurately reflects the current state of the codebase after the file's removal.
